errors.item: Retreat of Mega Sharpedo ex: Energy discarded (and end-board Energy count)
errors.g: Retreat discards 1 Water Energy (t=221-222); end board lists Mega Sharpedo ex with 0 Energy
errors.truth: No Energy discarded. Mega Sharpedo ex has 1 Water before the retreat (t=219) and still 1 Water on the Bench (t=226, 228, 235). Mega Gyarados ex goes from 3 to 4 Water only through the Energy Zone attach at t=226.

errors.g: Third discarded card visible at t=233 is Steel Apron (also in OPPONENT_review notes and UNCERTAINTIES)
errors.truth: Identities of the 3 discarded cards are not readable (top of discard at t=232 is Pokemon Center Lady; at t=234 a different unreadable card). Steel Apron is on top only at t=235, after Mega Mawile ex is Knocked Out, because its attached Tool goes to the discard; it was in play all game.
